text: ha can you believe we actually did it we made it through the storm wind howling rain lashing i thought we'd never see the sun again there were nights nights i cried myself to sleep whispering is anyone even out there but then you showed up you smiled as suddenly the world wasn't so dark i felt seen understood then buildsremember that silly dance in the kitchen with burnt pancakes oh we were a mess but now now you've gone the silence is deafening i miss you every single day but i carry you with me in every laugh every tear every quiet moment and i'll keep going because that's what you would want always
